main_body: T-shaped wooden timber prop (horizontal header beam on a vertical support post)
top_band: light tan/ochre wooden top surface on rows 10-12 (under dark brown outline on row 9), followed by a bright cream front-edge highlight on row 13
evidence: The horizontal crossbeam clearly shows a 3-row light tan top surface (rows 10-12) plus a 1-row cream front-edge highlight (row 13), above a 3-row darker brown front face of the beam (rows 14-16) and a 1-row bottom edge (row 17). Below the beam, the vertical post extends from row 18 to 47 and is recessed/shaded directly under the beam on rows 18-19.

style.evidence: The wood uses a 6-step warm brown/tan ramp (cream highlight, light tan, mid brown, warm brown, dark brown, deep espresso outline). Both the crossbeam and the vertical post have pixel-level wood grain, knots, joint banding (rows 30-31), and cast shadow, matching the Beodeul reference craft.
